name: Review: Chords & Scales
instructions: Spend today reviewing across everything so far: chord shapes, the C major scale, and any songs you have learned.
Notice which area (chords, scales, or two-hand coordination) still feels weakest, and plan extra time there going forward.
Play through the C major scale once more, then transition directly into a chord you know.
Revisit today's beginner piano video as a reminder of how far you have come since Day 2.
